_help: Which question types from the portal HTML go into the End-of-Sprint Test.
mcq = multiple choice · code = Python coding problem · text = written answer (e.g. write a prompt).
next: the next Sprint. Once the current Sprint has closed, the server switches to it ONCE (Sprint ID, title, window, duration),
as if a super admin had saved it in Admin → Sprint settings. A new Sprint ID gives fresh attempts and a new leaderboard.
Times are ISO with the IST offset. Later changes in Admin → Sprint settings win; the switch never runs again for the same id.
Run `npm run build` after changing this.
